body:
OPERATOR DECISION (Joe, 2026-11-17 11:06 MST, in the product seat's terminal): YES. Go ahead with drain mode.

- Set `--mode drain` on ordinary bug and task specs at approval from now on. Start with the specs behind the PRs that are approved and green now.
- Stay supervised (no drain): anything touching gate, mandate, authority, credentials, containment or other protected code, plus the landing-machinery bugs (train, review-watch, deputy, auto-train).
- Leave a one-line comment on each spec you set to drain, so we can audit afterwards which specs landed unattended.
- This is a stopgap until STORY-2884 (unset-mode project setting) lands. Please also dispose BUG-2663 (the mandate refuses unheld supervised PRs).
- The operator still needs to run `aida deputy shell run` to bring review-watch and auto-train back.

Product will tag drain on ordinary bug and task specs as it grooms and queues them.
subject: OPERATOR YES: drain mode on ordinary bug/task specs (with exclusions)
